Glowbal · Design evolution

How the Glowbal design language grew up

A walk through the five biggest design milestones of the product’s first three months — from a five-way identity experiment to today’s light, all-in-one platform. Built for the next designer joining the team: read the story here, then open any era as a running branch.

Span 25 Apr – 22 Jun 2026 Milestones 5 eras Source real git history, one branch each

Visit any era live

Each era is a real branch on GitHub. Check one out and run it locally to click through the actual product of that week — or point a Vercel preview at the branch with your Supabase env for a shareable URL.

# swap in any branch below
git checkout design-era/1-landing-showcase
npm install && npm run dev   # → http://localhost:3000
1
The casting call Week of 25 Apr 2026

Five identities, picked live

The first real design artifact wasn’t a page — it was a chooser. A GSAP-animated landing let the team switch between five complete visual identities in real time and feel each one before committing.

Cosmos
Deep-space navy, cyan glow, a single giant “Find your world.” — the direction that would go on to win.
Bloom
Soft blush ground, near-black rounded display, a calmer editorial voice.
Electric / Aurora / Journey
Higher-energy, gradient-nebula, and warmer explorations — the full spread of where the brand could have gone.
Branch design-era/1-landing-showcase · commit 93b0c3e
2
From poster to product Week of 5 May 2026

The dark direction becomes an app

Cosmos won. “Study without limits.” anchors a confident dark hero, a real top navigation appears, and the first account flow is wired — auth guard, onboarding, university explorer and the AI writer behind it.

Ground
Flat deep-navy with a starfield; the gradient wordmark (pink→cyan) is now the fixed brand signature.
System parts
First rounded pill navigation and the two-column auth card with the pink primary button that survives to today.
Branch design-era/2-full-user-flow · commit b2f6fef
3
The pill-nav era Week of 22 May 2026

Mentorship becomes a Hub

The 1-2-1 offering is rebuilt as a searchable Mentorship Hub with Stripe payments — the first screen where the product surfaces real structure: a search bar, filter chips, and a numbered how-it-works.

Navigation
Outlined pink pills replace the plain bar; the wordmark gains its globe “O”.
Surfaces
White cards on a soft lilac ground; filter chips (Personal statement, Interview prep…) and a designed empty-state set the pattern for every list screen that follows.
Branch design-era/3-mentorship-hub · commit d17d8a2
4
Depth & atmosphere Week of 25 May 2026

The hero gains a sky

A pass focused purely on polish: an SVG icon system, Google Reviews and City Images bring in real imagery, and the flat navy hero matures into a layered nebula with an aurora glow.

Atmosphere
“Your future is global” over a deep aurora gradient — the dark theme at its most cinematic.
Consistency
Icons and cards are now systematised rather than one-off, readying the language to scale across pages.
Branch design-era/4-visual-polish · commit 258190b
5
Light & all-in-one Week of 22 Jun 2026

The language flips to light

The biggest shift of all. The marketing site turns bright and confident, the app grows a persistent left sidebar, and AI course search plus a multi-select Apply shortlist arrive. This is the design language as it stands today.

Marketing
A light hero — “Find the right university and scholarship” — with a proof band (10,000+ · 2,000+ · $500,000+ · 200+) and a full nav.
App shell
A persistent left sidebar (Home · Search · Mentorship · News) and a gradient “Welcome back” sign-in — the shell the current product still uses.
Branch design-era/5-ai-course-apply · commit 7b908d1

Where it stands now

Era 5 is essentially today’s language: a light marketing surface, a persistent app sidebar, pink→cyan gradient accents and rounded cards throughout. The main branch carries the latest refinements (sticky university toolbar, mobile bottom nav, scholarship cards). Everything before it is preserved in the design-era/* branches so the journey stays walkable.
